name: demo-playwright-rust
summary: A small Rust walkthrough demo that uses the playwright-rs crate to launch Chromium, navigate to testingexamples.github.io, and demonstrate locator strategies and form interactions.
description: Demonstration of Playwright browser automation using Rust and the playwright-rs crate, launching Chromium to navigate to https://testingexamples.github.io and demonstrate locating elements by id, name, class, link text, and XPath, then filling a text input, checking a checkbox, checking a radio button, and selecting an option in a select element.
